doc: Per (backend, profile) ceiling on the recorded first-minus-repeat delta in milliseconds. The historical field startup_tax_ms = (molt_cold_total - molt_warm_total) * 1000 subtracts a repeated fresh-process median from the first invocation. Both phases include startup; cache state is uncontrolled, and the delta includes cache effects and noise. It does not isolate startup or body execution. Values, arithmetic and FAIL_COLD_BUDGET decisions remain unchanged: the ceiling is exceeded when startup_tax_ms > budget_ms. The v0 values retain their historical measured-baseline provenance; correcting terminology does not recalibrate them or transfer another experiment's startup decomposition into this metric.

native/release-fast.basis: Historical v0 first-minus-repeat delta: measured max 341ms + ~10% headroom, rounded. The recorded source board passed this ceiling. These observations do not isolate binary page-in or establish current release acceptance.

native/release-output.basis: No release-output board baseline recorded here (the v0 board is release-fast). A future ceiling requires a release-output board measured with this first-minus-repeat process scope. Separate same-path startup experiments do not seed this field.

llvm/release-fast.basis: Historical v0 first-minus-repeat delta: measured max 307ms + ~10% headroom, rounded. The recorded source board passed this ceiling; it does not establish current release acceptance.
